a: CORRECTION to the same-day claim that the 512-token clamp was a plausible contributor to the unembedded-concept damage — measured against the live dogfood store 2026-08-22, it is NOT the dominant cause. Coverage is 34 embedded of 509 concepts (93% unembedded), and the gap does not track length: concepts under 400 chars are 2/247 embedded, worse than the 400-1200 band at 32/232, while 1200-2400 is 0/30. Sub-400-char concepts never reach the 512-token clamp, so something else — the originally recorded cause, the embedder unreachable or refusing silently across whole sessions — accounts for the bulk. The clamp is still real and still worth its fix (it hard-fails every long input), but it is a second failure mode, not the explanation. Recency confirms the split: the ten newest concepts are 9/10 embedded (written after the clamp fix, with the embedder up), every earlier 100-row band is 2-8%.

a: The dogfood store's embedding damage is 475 of 509 concepts, far larger than the '92 of 100' figure carried in K's motivating table — that number is stale and understates the backfill by roughly 5x. Two consequences. First, semantic recall on this store is effectively not running: any lambo_recall here matches on keywords for 93% of the corpus, so recall-quality judgements made against the dogfood graph are judgements about the keyword path, not the hybrid one. Second, this raises the value of K2's re-embed verb and its embedded/total counter in lambo_stats — the counter would have made the drift visible the day it started, and the verb is now repairing 93% of the store rather than a tenth of it. Worth re-measuring coverage before any G recall-calibration work, since calibration against a 7%-embedded corpus would measure the wrong pipeline.

a: J2 round-3 residual coupling, handed to J3 as ONE item: the pump's un-raced client-facing writes and the uncapped `inflight` list are the same problem. answer_lost (src/mcp/proxy.rs:1457) writes one frame per in-flight id, so the ceiling J3 chooses for outstanding receipts is also the worst-case LENGTH of an un-raced write burst to a client that may not be reading. Neither §J2 nor DIAL_BUDGET's residual section says the other exists, and both undercount the writes as 'two' when there are six un-raced Self::send sites (proxy.rs:1298, 1321, 1349, 1375, 1393, 1457).
b: J3 resolution of the COUPLED ceiling residual handed over by J2-R2-7 / J2-R3-3. The coupling is real and its mechanism is receipt WAITING: a lambo_receipt call that waits is a long-lived in-flight request at the proxy, so N concurrent receipt waits are N entries in the pump's `inflight` list and therefore N frames in answer_lost's un-raced write burst. J3 therefore bounds BOTH ends: RECEIPT_WAIT_MAX caps how long any one wait can occupy an inflight slot, and a concurrent-waiter cap keeps the population under proxy.rs's INFLIGHT_DEPTH_WARN = 64. The queue bound itself does NOT feed the inflight list — a non-waiting ack returns immediately — so the residual's phrasing (the receipt ceiling IS the burst length) is true only of the waiting surface, and that correction belongs in the record.
